questions.text: Rearrange the following four sentences (A), (B), (C), and (D) in the correct sequence to form a coherent paragraph. A. However, the rapid pace of urbanization has strained these resources to a breaking point. B. Indian cities have historically been engines of economic growth and cultural exchange. C. Consequently, urban local bodies are now mandated to adopt sustainable waste management practices. D. This pressure has led to severe air pollution, water scarcity, and unmanageable solid waste. Choose the correct order from the options below.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Spot the opening sentence (independent, general statement) → B. 'However' in A contrasts B, so A follows B. 'This pressure' in D refers to 'strain' in A, so D follows A. 'Consequently' in C concludes the result, so C is last. Order: BADC. Step-by-step: Sentence B introduces the topic 'Indian cities'. Sentence A begins with 'However', signaling a contrast to the positive history in B, making B-A a mandatory pair. Sentence D starts with 'This pressure', a demonstrative pronoun referencing the 'strain' mentioned in A, fixing A-D as the next link. Sentence C starts with 'Consequently', indicating the final outcome of the pressure described in D. Thus, the logical flow is B → A → D → C.

questions.text: What approximate value should come in place of the question mark (?) in the following expression? (You are not expected to calculate the exact value.) √(1023.99) × 19.98% of 450.02 ÷ 15.99 = ?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Round values to nearest integers: √1024 = 32; 20% of 450 = 90; 15.99 ≈ 16. Compute 32 × 90 ÷ 16 = 32 × 5.625 = 180. Option elimination confirms 180 is closest. Full: √1023.99 ≈ 32. 19.98% of 450.02 ≈ 0.2 × 450 = 90. 32 × 90 = 2880. 2880 ÷ 15.99 ≈ 2880 ÷ 16 = 180.

questions.text: Rearrange the following four sentences (A), (B), (C), and (D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. (A) Consequently, the volume of digital transactions has witnessed exponential growth over the last five years. (B) The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) has revolutionized the way Indians transfer money. (C) This interoperable system allows users to link multiple bank accounts in a single mobile application. (D) It was launched by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) in 2016.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Opening Sentence & Mandatory Pairs. B is the general introduction (Best opener). D follows B (Launch details of 'It'). C follows D (Feature of 'This system'). A concludes with 'Consequently' (Result). Sequence: B-D-C-A. Eliminate options not starting with B (D). Eliminate options where C doesn't follow D (A, C). Worked Solution: Sentence B introduces UPI. Sentence D gives the launch detail ('It was launched...'). Sentence C explains the feature ('This interoperable system...'). Sentence A shows the result ('Consequently...'). The logical flow is BDCA.

questions.text: A boat covers 36 km downstream in 2 hours and the same distance upstream in 3 hours. What is the speed of the stream (in km/h)?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Downstream speed = 36/2 = 18 km/h. Upstream speed = 36/3 = 12 km/h. Speed of stream = (Downstream - Upstream)/2 = (18 - 12)/2 = 3 km/h. Full: Let speed of boat in still water be b and stream be s. b + s = 18 and b - s = 12. Adding equations: 2b = 30 ⇒ b = 15. Substituting: s = 18 - 15 = 3 km/h.

questions.text: In a certain code language: 'railway track signal' is coded as 'mk rt pb' 'track safety zone' is coded as 'rt ze qs' 'signal zone clear' is coded as 'pb qs xy' What is the code for 'safety'?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Intersection method. 'track' common in 1st & 2nd -> code 'rt'. 'zone' common in 2nd & 3rd -> code 'qs'. 'signal' common in 1st & 3rd -> code 'pb'. In 2nd statement 'track safety zone' = 'rt ze qs', remaining code 'ze' stands for 'safety'. Full: Map words: railway=mk, track=rt, signal=pb, safety=ze, zone=qs, clear=xy. Safety corresponds to ze.

questions.text: Which of the following phrases should replace the underlined phrase to make the sentence grammatically correct? If the sentence is correct, mark 'No improvement'. Scarcely the meeting had started when the power went off.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Trigger word 'Scarcely' (or 'Hardly') at the beginning of a sentence mandates Subject-Auxiliary Inversion (Aux + Subject + Main Verb) and is followed by 'when', not 'than'. Step-by-step: The original sentence lacks inversion ('the meeting had started'). Option A provides correct inversion ('had the meeting started') and correct conjunction ('when'). Option B uses 'than' (incorrect with Scarcely). Option C uses 'did... start' (wrong auxiliary for Past Perfect context).

questions.text: Choose the option that best expresses the meaning of the idiom highlighted in the sentence. The new CEO decided to **call a spade a spade** during the annual general meeting, addressing the financial irregularities directly.

options.label: B
options.text: To resign from a position abruptly

questions.solution: Shortcut: Idiom 'Call a spade a spade' is a standard fixed expression meaning 'to speak plainly/truthfully without euphemism'. Eliminate options describing specific actions (investigate, resign, postpone) rather than a manner of speaking. Step-by-step: 1) Recognize the idiom. 2) Literal meaning: Calling a gardening tool by its name. 3) Figurative meaning: Describing something as it really is, bluntly. 4) Context clue: 'addressing... directly' supports bluntness. 5) Option A (investigation) is a process, not speech style. Option B (resign) is an action. Option D (postpone) is avoidance. Option C matches definition and context.

questions.text: In a row of students, Ankit is 12th from the left end and 18th from the right end. If 5 new students join the row and stand at the right end, what will be Ankit's new position from the right end?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Position from right increases by the number of people added at the right end. Old position from right = 18. 5 added at right -> New position = 18 + 5 = 23. Full: Total students initially = 12 + 18 - 1 = 29. After 5 join at right, total = 34. Ankit's position from left remains 12. New position from right = 34 - 12 + 1 = 23.

questions.text: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 3 : 2. After 10 years, the ratio of their ages will become 7 : 5. What was the ratio of their ages 5 years ago?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use reverse option elimination. Since the time gap between '5 years ago' and '10 years hence' is 15 years, add 15 years to the ages assumed from each option (in ratio form) and check which yields the future ratio 7:5. For option C (11:7), let ages 5 years ago be 11k and 7k. Present ages = 11k+5, 7k+5. Given present ratio 3:2 ⇒ 2(11k+5)=3(7k+5) ⇒ k=5. Ages 10 years hence = 60+10, 40+10 = 70:50 = 7:5 (matches). Full Solution: Let present ages be 3x and 2x. (3x+10)/(2x+10) = 7/5 ⇒ 15x+50 = 14x+70 ⇒ x=20. Present ages = 60, 40. Ages 5 years ago = 55, 35 = 11:7.

questions.text: In a family of seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F, and G, there are two married couples. B is the son of C. A is the mother of B. D is the brother of E. F is the mother-in-law of A. G is the grandfather of D. E is the sister of D. How is E related to G?
questions.solution: Shortcut: 'Mother-in-law of A' (F) implies F is mother of A's husband. Since B is son of C and A is mother of B, C is A's husband. So F is mother of C. 'Grandfather of D' (G) implies G is father of D's parent. As F is mother of C, G is husband of F and father of C. Thus C is child of G. B, D, E are children of A and C (siblings). Since E is sister of D, E is female. Hence E is granddaughter of G. Full Solution: Couple 1: F (Mother-in-law of A) & G. So F is mother of C (A's husband). Couple 2: A & C. Children of A & C: B (Son), D, E (Siblings, E is sister). G is father of C. Therefore E is granddaughter of G.

questions.text: Rohan walks 15 metres West, turns left and walks 20 metres, turns left again and walks 15 metres, then turns right and walks 10 metres. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Track net horizontal and vertical displacement. Horizontal: 15m West (-15) then 15m East (+15) = 0. Vertical: 20m South (-20) then 10m South (-10) = 30m South. Distance = 30m. Full: Start (0,0). West 15 -> (-15,0). Left (South) 20 -> (-15,-20). Left (East) 15 -> (0,-20). Right (South) 10 -> (0,-30). Distance = √(0² + 30²) = 30 metres.

questions.text: In a row of students, A is 12th from the left end and B is 18th from the right end. There are 8 students sitting between A and B, and A is to the left of B. What is the total number of students in the row?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Since A is left of B with 8 students between, Total = Rank_A_Left + Between + Rank_B_Right = 12 + 8 + 18 = 38. Full: Visualize row: [11 students][A][8 students][B][17 students]

questions.text: Identify the segment in the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is error-free, select the segment labelled 'No error' (though all segments below are parts of the sentence). The committee is comprised of experts from various fields, who are expected to deliberate on the proposal and submitting their report by next month.

options.label: B
options.text: experts from various fields, who are

options.label: C
options.text: expected to deliberate on the proposal and

options.label: D
options.text: submitting their report by next month

questions.solution: Shortcut: Scan for parallelism after 'to' (infinitives). The structure 'expected to [verb1] and [verb2]' requires both verbs in base form. 'Deliberate' (base) pairs with 'submit' (base), not 'submitting' (gerund). Step-by-step: 1) Segment A: 'Comprised of' is often debated but accepted in modern usage; 'comprises' is stricter but not the primary error here. 2) Segment B: Correct relative clause usage. 3) Segment C: 'Expected to deliberate' is correct. 4) Segment D: 'Expected to... and submitting' violates parallelism. The bare infinitive 'submit' is required after 'to'. Error lies in Segment D.

questions.text: Find the missing term in the following number series: 12, 13, 17, 26, 42, ?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Check differences between consecutive terms: 1, 4, 9, 16 (perfect squares 1², 2², 3², 4²). Next difference is 5² = 25. Missing term = 42 + 25 = 67. Step-by-step: 13-12=1; 17-13=4; 26-17=9; 42-26=16; Pattern n²; Next diff=25; 42+25=67.

questions.text: Refer to the table below showing the number of employees in three departments over four years. Year | Dept X | Dept Y | Dept Z 2018 | 120 | 80 | 100 2019 | 150 | 100 | 120 2020 | 180 | 120 | 150 2021 | 200 | 150 | 180 What is the approximate percentage increase in the total number of employees from 2018 to 2021?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Sum the employees for 2018 (120+80+100=300) and 2021 (200+150+180=530). Increase = 230. Percentage increase = (230/300)×100 = 76.67%. Full solution: Total employees in 2018 = 300. Total employees in 2021 = 530. Increase = 530 - 300 = 230. Percentage increase = (Increase/Original)×100 = (230/300)×100 = 76.666...% ≈ 76.67%.
